target.title: [codex] Prevent stale review comment sync overwrites
target.body:
## Summary

- Prevent stale apply/comment-sync runs from overwriting a newer durable ClawSweeper review comment.
- Trust only pull-request review comments that are bot-owned, have the durable review marker as the final footer, and expose a trailing automation verdict marker with a newer `reviewed_at`.
- Add regression coverage for the real overwrite race plus untrusted/user-authored markers, forged marker prose, forged review footers, and issue comments.

## Root cause

A long-running apply/comment-sync job could load older state and later PATCH the durable review comment after a newer exact-review run had already updated it. Because the sync path compared desired body/hash metadata but did not check live review freshness, it could roll the public comment from a newer review back to an older one.

## Validation

- `pnpm run build`
- `pnpm exec node --test test/clawsweeper.test.ts`
- `pnpm run format:check`
- `autoreview --mode local --codex-bin /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/lib/node_modules/@openai/codex/node_modules/@openai/codex-linux-x64/vendor/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/bin/codex ...`

## Autoreview

Codex autoreview initially found trust-boundary issues in the freshness parser. Accepted and fixed:

- Do not trust user-authored marker comments.
- Do not trust marker-shaped text in generated review prose.
- Do not apply PR verdict-tail freshness logic to issue comments.
- Require the durable `clawsweeper-review` marker to be the final footer before trusting the preceding verdict marker.

Final autoreview result: `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
